experiment: I4F complete simplified internal discharge apparatus: water/air hydraulic reference
status: exploratory; all apparatus dimensions except nominal nozzle size are assumptions
coordinate_frame: stationary apparatus; x discharge direction, y horizontal cross-stream, z upward; SI units

connection.end_condition: gas first reaches upper edge of pipe entrance; single-liquid reduced model stops here

pipe.entrance_K_reference: pipe mean velocity; square-edged reservoir entrance approximation, not measured I4F data; DOI 10.1061/JIDEDH.IRENG-10219 Table 2, approximate sensitivity 0.3-0.7
pipe.transition_K_reference: pipe mean velocity; assumed sensitivity input, not a measured transition coefficient

gas.qualification: air reference permits two-phase gas/water CFD with external air; does not reproduce CO2 pressurization, dissolution or mixing. User describes sealed waiting/discharge after CO2 charging at roughly 8-10 bar; gauge versus absolute convention is unconfirmed. Mainly liquid with a gas headspace is the user's uncertain current interpretation; pre-existing dispersed bubbles are not confirmed.

valve.minimum_opening_qualification: Declared finite-bleed regularization: effective opening=max(smoothstep command,0.02), not measured closed-valve leakage. Existing CFD uses this value; original closed-valve reduced histories are preserved separately.
valve.representation: time-dependent scalar restriction; not resolved butterfly disk; Cd and area law provisional
valve.qualification: cannot predict disk wake or asymmetric valve jet; do not infer outlet uniformity robustness to resolved valve geometry

lamellae.qualification: user reports five lamellae beginning roughly halfway through expansion; the initial no-vane reference omits this actual hardware feature

provenance.user_hardware_description: Charged with CO2 to roughly 8-10 bar and waits sealed before discharge, like a soda can. User thinks mainly liquid before charging with a gas headspace, but is unsure. Initial gas composition, dispersed bubbles, dissolved gas and gauge/absolute convention unconfirmed.
provenance.all_other_values: declared provisional inputs, not hardware measurements
